Traffic from proxied apps goes through Material Xray. Apps marked as “Not proxied” will use the other VPN when it is connected.

Material Xray will take priority for apps selected for proxying in Routing, while apps explicitly marked as “Not proxied” will use another configured VPN (one that uses Android’s built-in VPN service) when it is active.

Otherwise, these apps will connect directly.

Proxied apps can still access the other VPN’s networks through that VPN. For example, a browser can open websites through Material Xray and reach a home server through Tailscale. This exception does not apply to apps with “Always proxied” enabled.
App traffic will be routed through another active VPN, while Material Xray proxies the VPN app itself.

App traffic will be routed through another active VPN, while Material Xray proxies the VPN app itself. This could be useful for apps like Tailscale that use Android’s built-in VPN service and have trouble connecting directly.\n\nThe other VPN app should be configured to use a proxy in Routing.
Prioritize another VPN while it is connected. Material Xray stays running and resumes automatically once that VPN disconnects.
